Scenario fixture: rgaa-svg-decorative-aria-hidden (RGAA 1.2.4)

Each target has a stable id of the form sda_case_NN. A decorative <svg> needs aria-hidden="true"; one marked role="presentation" without it fails, and other exposed SVGs that may be decorative are asked about.

01 — FAIL: role="presentation" without aria-hidden

Contact

02 — CANTTELL: icon beside a button's text
03 — CANTTELL: unnamed exposed SVG
04 — NOT APPLICABLE: hidden with aria-hidden
05 — NOT APPLICABLE: the only content of a link (it carries information)
06 — NOT APPLICABLE: role="img"
